Look at the shape before reaching for the lever — which is the same finding the delivered-fair-value calibration reached from the other direction, and neither was visible without plotting the names.

log.what: Credits ran out mid-fan-out. Two answer audits and four rendered-page reads returned before it; every VERIFICATION agent failed, so all of it was recorded as unverified in ANSWER_AUDIT_05-09-2026.md. Then verified the largest claim BY HAND: ADNOCDIST's commercial margin applies a 17% step to the realised H1-2026 level, and the study's own input register says that 17% IS the realised first-half outcome. Counted twice. The implied second half of 2026 is 0.5847 AED/L against 0.4363 just filed, compounding through all five years. Recorded as finding 7, VERIFIED, in the study's audit file.
log.lesson: WHEN THE VERIFIER CANNOT RUN, VERIFY IT YOURSELF RATHER THAN BANKING IT. The finding was sitting in a file marked unverified and would have stayed there; the check that settled it was three lines of arithmetic against the study's own committed numbers and its own source field. An unverified finding is not a confirmed one — but nor is it a finding you are entitled to leave alone when the means to test it are in the room.

log.what: Session limit reset at 02:00 UTC and ten workflows were relaunched; every agent then returned OUT OF USAGE CREDITS, which is the account balance rather than the session window. Committed what had landed: ARCC's valuation-input block (8 origins x 7 items, 8 share counts refused rather than carried back), AMR's terminal note (STOPS on a residual-value depreciation policy rather than choosing a life), and four studies read page by page as images — 234 pages, 83 candidates raised, all 83 refuted.
log.lesson: TWO LIMITS WEAR THE SAME COSTUME. A session window resets on a clock and a credit balance does not, and both arrive as an agent that will not start. Reading the message rather than the symptom is what separates 'wait two hours' from 'this will not fix itself' — and the second one is reportable while the first is not.

log.what: CORRECTED MY OWN CENSUS. log.lesson: TWO LESSONS, BOTH ABOUT SAMPLES THAT SORT THEMSELVES. (1) Three names still carrying a blend is a sample selected on NOT YET CORRECTED, and whatever reasons drove the earlier conformances had already sorted the population before anybody measured it — which is [R-TERM-01 CLAUSE TWO]'s own lesson arriving in this session's work within hours of my quoting it. (2) A PROBE MUST RESEMBLE THE WORK IT GATES: a haiku probe with no tool use passed three times while every real agent failed the same minute, so its success was evidence about the probe and not about the balance. What stands in both cases is the part that never rested on the direction — a blend is an untested free parameter, and the sharper reading is WORSE for it: the answer moves tens of per cent in an UNPREDICTABLE direction.

log.lesson: SECOND INSTANCE TODAY OF ONE SHAPE, WHICH IS [R-LESSON-01]'s bar for widening. This morning a haiku credit probe passed three times while every real agent failed the same minute, and its success was evidence about the probe. Tonight a hostname that does not resolve produced a confident 'cannot be obtained' that reached the escalation register and blocked a name for a day. BOTH ARE THE SAME THING: A FAILED OR PASSING PROBE IS EVIDENCE ABOUT THE PROBE BEFORE IT IS EVIDENCE ABOUT THE WORLD. [R-ENF-04] already says an empty result is not a clean result and to re-run the exact operation before believing an absence — what both cases add is that RE-RUNNING THE SAME WRONG PROBE CONFIRMS NOTHING. The 5-Sep entry was re-run twice against the same non-resolving host and the re-runs were recorded as corroboration.

log.what: CLOSED THE CLASS RATHER THAN THE INSTANCE [R-ENF-01]. BOROUGE's diagnostics script ran, exited 0 and wrote nothing — no json.dump, no main guard — so the whole artefact class was swept. Twelve studies carry the instrument and ALL TWELVE have both a write and a __main__ guard and both artefacts on disk; BOROUGE was the only one of its shape and is now finished. Twelve studies carry no diagnostics script at all and sit on the output-records ratchet, which is the declared state rather than the silent one. Then the harder test, because a static screen cannot see staleness: every one of the twelve generators was RE-RUN and its artefacts diffed. ALL TWELVE REPRODUCE BYTE-IDENTICALLY.
log.lesson: A CLEAN SWEEP IS A RESULT AND IS WORTH THE SAME HOUR AS A DIRTY ONE. The workbook instruments, run the same way a day earlier, came back with two red — SWDY publishing a workbook 6.9% away from its own document, and AMOC's recalculation written for a nine-sheet file that had become sixteen. Running the diagnostics generators found nothing, and that is evidence [R-ENF-06]'s discipline is holding on this artefact class rather than a wasted pass. The two sweeps together are the argument for running instruments rather than counting files: you cannot know which kind of answer you will get, which is precisely why the run has to happen.
